timing: Written after source-method inspection and inspection of one file's schema and target gene values, before full-cohort summaries. This is a retrospective reproduction, not preregistration.
question: What Wnt and fibroblast-marker expression is present in the 47 deposited adult mesenchymal single cells, and how sensitive is the reported Pdgfra fraction among Wnt5a-positive cells to an unstated positivity cutoff?
primary_cohort: All 47 deposited single cells in GSE109444; exclude GSM2943054 (approximately 200-cell bulk control) from every cell fraction.
display_threshold_rationale: Transparent expression convention anchored to the paper's housekeeping QC threshold; the paper does not identify this as its Wnt/Pdgfra positivity threshold.
figure_transform: log2(1+FPKM), explicitly differing from the paper's label log2 FPKM because zero handling is unspecified there
cell_order: Descending Wnt5a, descending Pdgfra, then accession; same order in both expression panels. Original clustering/order is not reconstructed.
qc: Report >=1 FPKM in at least 3/4 Actb, Gapdh, Ubc, Ppia as a diagnostic. Do not invent the paper's incompletely specified three-SD QC or remove cells from the primary deposited cohort.
inference: Descriptive cell fractions only; no animal-level test, confidence interval or pseudoreplication. No spatial proximity, functional Wnt secretion, niche causality or modern subtype identification from this matrix.
